gloss: crossing a major milestone; reaching a round number

definitions.gloss: crossing a major milestone; reaching a round number
definitions.explanation: surpassing a significant round-number threshold, typically used for stock prices, sales figures, ages, or other numerical milestones

examples.japanese: ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大台乗|おおだいの}せ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The stock price crossed a major milestone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大台乗|おおだいの}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: We're aiming to hit the next major sales milestone.

examples.japanese: {日経平均|にっけいへいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{四万円|よんまんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大台乗|おおだいの}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}→達成：04816_tassei⟧し、⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{活気|かっき}→活気：02554_kakki⟧づいた。
examples.english: The Nikkei average crossed the 40,000-yen milestone, energizing the market.

notes:
Combines ⟦{大台|おおだい}→大台：12249_oodai⟧ (major level, round-number threshold) and {乗|の}せ (placing on, putting onto). ⟦{大台|おおだい}→大台：12249_oodai⟧ originally refers to the high-value digit columns on an abacus. In modern usage, it means a significant round number (e.g., 10,000, 100,000, 1 million). Commonly used in financial news, sports statistics, and age milestones.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大台乗|おおだいの}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}する→達成する：22183_tasseisuru⟧: to achieve a major milestone
- {大台乗|おおだいの}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to accomplish a major milestone
- ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大台乗|おおだいの}せ: first milestone-crossing in a long time
- ⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大台乗|おおだいの}せ: first time crossing a major milestone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大台割|おおだいわ}れ→大台割れ：26057_oodaiware⟧: falling below a major milestone — the opposite, when a value drops below a round-number threshold
- ⟦{大台|おおだい}→大台：12249_oodai⟧: major level; major milestone — the threshold itself
- ⟦{突破|とっぱ}→突破：13755_toppa⟧: breakthrough — a more general term for surpassing a limit or barrier
